verdict.rationale: Sift docs confirm a Review Queues feature exists alongside Workflows for making decisions on flagged events, and community evidence corroborates that customers have analysts manually review flagged users to make accept/reject decisions. However, no evidence describes the queue's UI showing full context like customer history, similar/related cases, or consolidated signal views — the specifics of the review experience are unevidenced. Missing for 10: documentation or screenshots of the review queue UI, evidence of customer-history views, similar-case surfacing, and analyst workflow details beyond the single case-by-case decision.
